watch.summary: The streamer reacts to an esports broadcast replay where he feels the live crowd noise spoiled a player's surprise play.

beats.what: The streamer reacts with mild disappointment, claiming the crowd gave away the player's position.
The tournament broadcast switches to the replay of the round.
The streamer watches the replay angles while listening to the casters analyze the play.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Damn it bro, the crowd gave that away.
watch.why: This clip is serious esports match analysis rather than comedic content. A casual scroller without context on Valorant esports won't find anything humorous in it.
